stepNotes.1: Three lazy route exports begin at workflow.ts:167, :492, and :568 and are mounted under /workflow-runs, /workflow-templates, and /workflow-routines at server.ts:309-311.
stepNotes.2: The feature gate is applied independently to all three sub-apps; Zod bounds IDs, limits, filters, and scopes, while raw artifact payloads require includePayload=true and production listen rejects non-loopback hosts.
stepNotes.3: Create dispatch is exclusive because the body refinement requires one of templateID/spec; all detail and lifecycle responses compact artifacts, and retry selects phase or whole-run behavior after validation.
stepNotes.4: Run misses use storage NotFoundError and routines translate their domain errors, but plain WorkflowTemplateNotFoundError falls through plainErrorEnvelope to 500 despite route metadata declaring 404; accepted as Medium.
stepNotes.5: Dashboard performs list plus getDetail per run, and getDetail reads four child collections; limit is optional server-side although the TUI supplies limit=8, producing a Low scalability advisory.
stepNotes.6: HTTP metadata and validation stay in the route layer while workflow persistence/execution remain in domain modules; WorkflowRoutineRunBody duplicates domain RunInput and is a future schema-drift risk.
stepNotes.7: No TODO/FIXME or swallowed failure exists in workflow.ts; the known routine errors are translated and unknown errors rethrow, while small duplicate feature-gate middleware keeps each export independently safe.
stepNotes.8: workflow-routes.test.ts covers 12 behavioral cases across gating, lifecycle, malformed IDs, redaction, evals, templates, and routines, but never requests an unknown template over HTTP or stress-tests dashboard history.
stepNotes.9: Targeted Vitest passed 1 file and 12 tests; one Medium 404/500 defect and one Low dashboard advisory were recorded, with no Critical evidence and therefore no reverify.md from this primary lane.
